# porkbun_api_spend_settings (Data Source)

Returns the available account credit balance.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "porkbun_api_spend_settings" "test" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `monthly_spend` (Number) Total API spend in the current calendar month, in cents.
- `settings` (Attributes) Human-readable balance string (e.g. `$12.34`). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings))

<a id="nestedatt--settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `settings`

Read-Only:

- `auto_topup` (Boolean) Whether automatic balance top-up is enabled.
- `low_balance_alert` (Number) Send an alert email when balance drops below this amount (cents). `null` = disabled.
- `monthly_spend_limit` (Number) Maximum API spend per calendar month in cents. `null` means no limit.
- `topup_amount` (Number) Amount to add during an auto top-up (cents).
- `topup_threshold` (Number) Trigger auto top-up when balance falls below this amount (cents). `null` = disabled.
